description: This file contains a unit test class 'EmailConfigurationModelTest' which tests the 'EmailConfigurationModel' class related to email configuration within the OrangeHRM application's Admin API model. It verifies the 'toArray' method functionality that converts an EmailConfiguration entity to an array.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationModelTest
classes.description: A unit test class extending KernelTestCase that tests the EmailConfigurationModel class, particularly the toArray method.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests that the EmailConfigurationModel correctly converts an EmailConfiguration entity to an associative array matching expected values.
